I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store was **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from a June 9 conversation in #central-team, a channel she's a member of. Pree posted there that the morning receiver's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and have support test it with the store's login.

I couldn't find an address or site code for Pine Crossing in anything Pree has access to, so I told her that instead of guessing.
